reasoning: As of March 2026, US export controls on advanced AI chips to China have been increasingly restrictive since 2022. The Blackwell chips (B30A, B300) are Nvidia's most advanced AI accelerators. Given the trajectory of US-China tech tensions and the Biden administration's (and likely continuing) policy of restricting China's access to cutting-edge AI hardware, it's highly unlikely these restrictions would be lifted by May 2026. Nvidia has historically created China-specific variants to comply with restrictions, but direct sales of top-tier chips remain prohibited.
